svg.title: Board after the resources
svg.desc: Resources: / API: CPU, 100k/s / 10k/s per server = 10, +50% for a lost zone -> 15 / Queue: disk, 1 TB a day x 3 copies x 7 days = 21 TB -> 3 nodes x 8 TB / (assume a log node takes ~100k writes/s of 1 KB, copies included) / Message store: writes, 100k/s x 3 copies / 10k/s per node = 30, / +50% for a lost zone -> 45 (disk: 90 TB / 45 = 2 TB per node) / Latency of accept, 99%: 20 ms network + 5 ms API + 20 ms queue write < 100 ms

text.tspan: API: CPU, 100k/s / 10k/s per server = 10, +50% for a lost zone -> 15
Queue: disk, 1 TB a day x 3 copies x 7 days = 21 TB -> 3 nodes x 8 TB
(assume a log node takes ~100k writes/s of 1 KB, copies included)
Message store: writes, 100k/s x 3 copies / 10k/s per node = 30,
+50% for a lost zone -> 45 (disk: 90 TB / 45 = 2 TB per node)
Latency of accept, 99%: 20 ms network + 5 ms API + 20 ms queue write < 100 ms
